sources.entry: Koru - Offline-first, open-source workspace for notes and docs with end-to-end encrypted device-to-device sync, built in Rust. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/koruworks/mono) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]

summary.name: Koru
summary.one_liner: Koru is a free, open-source, offline-first notes and documents app that stores data in a local database, syncs directly between devices, and lets AI agents work on your documents.
use_cases: let AI agents edit your documents
sync notes between laptop and desktop without cloud
dictate notes by voice on device
migrate notes from Evernote or Notion
organise work and personal notes in separate profiles
summary.what_it_does: Koru is a notes and documents app that keeps your work in a local database on your device and works offline. It syncs directly between your devices using end-to-end encrypted peer-to-peer sync, with an optional paid-or-added Koru Cloud copy for always-online sync and backup. You can run AI agents such as Claude, Codex or Gemini as tabs beside your documents, and those agents can read and edit your workspace through Koru's local MCP server. It includes Koru Voice, which runs speech recognition on the device for dictation. Profiles let you separate work, school and personal workspaces, and the app can import notes from Evernote, Google Docs, Notion and Markdown.
notable: Runs AI agents (Claude, Codex, Gemini and others) as tabs and lets them edit documents over a local MCP server
On-device voice dictation via Koru Voice, with no audio sent to the cloud
Peer-to-peer end-to-end encrypted sync that does not require Koru Cloud
Open source code on GitHub, built in Rust
caveats: Koru Cloud is an optional add-on for always-online sync and backup; the page does not give its price
iOS and Android apps are listed as coming soon, not available
The app is available in English only for now
Several roadmap items (calendar integration, cloud API and MCP, EU cloud region) are planned or in development
